title: Huey, Dewey, and Louie
blurb: The most laid-back of Donald Duck's triplet nephews, usually shown in a green cap.
facts: Like their maternal uncles, the brothers are domestic anthropomorphic white ducks with yellow-orange bills and feet.
The boys are sometimes distinguished by the color of their shirts and baseball caps.
They appeared in many Donald Duck animated shorts, as well as in the television show DuckTales and its reboot, but the comics remain their primary medium.
